raw.rationale: BMS-387032 is a CDK2/7/9 inhibitor with additional MCL1 activity, and CDK9/MCL1 inhibition can selectively kill MCL1-dependent lineages such as hematologic cancers, but among the listed lineages only modest or no lineage-selective killing is expected at 2.5 µM in 5-day PRISM screens; published PRISM/CDK inhibitor data show weak lineage selectivity, with possible slight sensitivity in lung and breast lines but probabilities near baseline.
